raw_payload.description: Botanical garden in Bari, Apulia, Italy
raw_payload.extract: The Orto Botanico di APS Parco Domingo Comunità Empatica e Sostenibile – Bari, also known as the Orto Domingo, Orto dei Miracoli, and Hortus Botanicus Barensis, is a botanical garden in Bari, Apulia, Italy. The garden extends over an area of 11,500 m², located at via Edoardo Orabona 4 in Bari, in Apulia. It is open Monday through Friday mornings.
